name: bgrealestate-codex-hooks
notes: Repo-local hook pack. It does not modify ~/.codex/config.toml.
Use pre_command form from an external Codex wrapper if command-level blocking is desired.
Operator override env vars are intentionally explicit and narrow.

command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_LIVE_SCRAPE: allows live scrape commands after operator approval
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_MEDIA_BACKFILL: allows large media backfill after operator approval
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_ACTION0: allows Action0 image-report execution after operator Action0 now
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_ACTION2: allows Action2 source expansion after operator Action2 now
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_UNSAFE_IMPORT: allows explicit import include flags after backend/debugger approval
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_BROAD_GIT_ADD: allows broad git add only for ops-reviewed release work
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_SENSITIVE_STAGE: allows sensitive-path staging only for explicit operator/debugger review
command_overrides.CODEX_ALLOW_DB_ARTIFACT_STAGE: allows DB artifact staging only for exceptional, explicit approval
